facts.name: Kristie M. Healis
facts.assignment: Citrus felony criminal docket; profile states procedures effective June 22, 2026. No civil responsibility established by this profile.

contact.contact_note: Office email is the published courtesy-copy/proposed-order submission inbox, distinct from the assistant email; phone is shared office/assistant route, not a separate personal judge number.

chambers_communications.summary: Use assistant for office questions and the separate published submissions inbox for motions/orders. Copy opposing parties; do not contact judge directly about pending cases.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Motion must appear on docket before scheduling. Supply anticipated length and witness count; coordinate availability. Moving a proceeding requires court permission.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email courtesy motion and supporting-authority copies to the published submissions inbox, copying opposing parties.

proposed_orders.summary: Email only to submissions inbox; .docx with prescribed sample codes, case style/number in subject. Copy all parties; identify mailed copies for parties without email and comply with stated pro se mailing/certificate requirement. Sample and instruction links retained without expanding criminal review.

remote_appearances.summary: Request Zoom from assistant with case identity, date and reason. Permission is conditional on notice, applicable rules and objections; no blanket remote entitlement.

facts.summary: Noncivil basic review: assistant and separate submissions routes, docketed-motion scheduling, Word proposed orders and conditional Zoom requests. Criminal merits and detailed specialty procedures intentionally not reviewed.

review_scope.collected: Complete profile HTML and extracted text, including linked-document inventory.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, stated felony assignment/effective date, basic remote request and scheduling/submission rules, proposed-order block and public communication notice.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal pleas/forms, sentencing, capias/bond, trial calendars and detailed criminal preparation. Linked sample and general order instruction PDFs retained as links; not collected or substantively reviewed for this noncivil judge.

gaps: No distinct personal judge email or assistant-only number established in profile/roster.

citations.locator: Profile contact block, felony procedure introduction and basic scheduling/remote/submission sections; specialty criminal content not substantively reviewed
